title: Personal website
prompt: Build a personal website as a single HTML file: hero with name and tagline, about section, project highlights grid, and contact links. Clean modern typography, responsive layout.

title: Landing page
prompt: Build a product landing page as a single HTML file: hero with headline and CTA, three feature cards with icons, pricing table, testimonials, and a footer. Include subtle scroll animations.

title: Portfolio site
prompt: Build a designer portfolio website as a single HTML file: full-width hero, filterable project gallery with hover captions, about page, and a contact form layout.

title: Browser game
prompt: Create a browser game: a single HTML file with canvas gameplay, keyboard controls, score tracking, and a restart flow. Explain the game mechanics first, then implement.

title: Budget app
prompt: Build a personal budget app with a dashboard showing income, expenses, savings goals, and monthly spending bars. Include forms to add transactions and categorize them. Use HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Habit tracker
prompt: Build a habit tracker app: weekly grid of habits with check-off circles, streak counters, a progress summary, and localStorage persistence.

title: Kanban board
prompt: Build a Kanban task board: three columns (To do, Doing, Done), drag-and-drop cards between columns, card detail edit, and localStorage persistence.

title: Pomodoro timer
prompt: Build a Pomodoro timer app: 25-minute focus sessions with 5-minute breaks, start/pause/reset controls, session counter, and a gentle end-of-session chime.

title: Product launch deck
prompt: Create a product launch deck: 8-10 slides covering problem, solution, market, product demo, business model, traction, team, and ask. Write clear headlines and speaker notes for each slide.

title: Investor pitch
prompt: Create an investor pitch deck: 10 slides with a compelling narrative arc (hook, problem, solution, why now, market size, product, traction, competition, team, and the ask).

title: Quarterly review
prompt: Create a quarterly business review deck: goals vs. results, key wins, misses and root causes, metrics dashboard summary, and next-quarter priorities.

title: Course lessons
prompt: Create a short course deck introducing a topic of my choice: learning objectives, module-by-module lessons with key concepts, examples, and a summary quiz slide.

title: Technical spec
prompt: Draft a technical specification document: overview, goals and non-goals, architecture, data model, API surface, error handling, security considerations, and rollout plan.

title: User guide
prompt: Write a user guide for a product: getting-started tutorial, task-based how-to sections, FAQ, and troubleshooting table. Plain language, step-by-step.

title: Project proposal
prompt: Draft a project proposal: background, objectives, scope, deliverables, timeline with milestones, resource needs, risks with mitigations, and success metrics.

title: Meeting notes
prompt: Create a meeting notes template and fill a sample: attendees, agenda, decisions made, action items with owners and due dates, and open questions.

title: Logo concepts
prompt: Design logo concepts for a brand of my choice: three distinct directions with rationale, monochrome variants, and usage dos and don'ts.

title: Social media kit
prompt: Create a social media kit: profile and banner image concepts, a 5-post launch series with captions and hashtags, and a visual style summary.

title: Infographic
prompt: Design an infographic explaining a topic of my choice: headline stat, 4-5 data sections with icons and short captions, source notes, and a shareable layout.

title: Anime short
prompt: Create a short anime-style video concept: a neon street scene at sunset with a protagonist walking toward the camera. Provide a storyboard description, shot list, and mood references.

title: Product demo
prompt: Script a 60-second product demo video: hook, problem, three feature demos with on-screen actions, and a closing CTA. Include shot directions and voiceover lines.

title: Explainer animation
prompt: Plan an explainer animation: simplify a complex topic of my choice into a 90-second script with scene-by-scene visual metaphors and narration.

title: Expense tracker
prompt: Create an expense tracker spreadsheet: monthly tabs, category totals with formulas, a summary dashboard, and conditional formatting for overspending.

title: Market scan
prompt: Research a market of my choice: key players, segments and sizes, recent trends, and a one-page brief with cited sources.
